description: Trace the contour/outline of a blob or silhouette into vector line art: source → monochrome → blur → threshold (the blob mask, optionally inverted) → optional Edge (boundary-band only) → Trace SOP (mask-to-polyline) → wireframe render. This is the CONTOUR-TRACE complement to create_vector_lines (full image vectoriser) and export_sop_to_svg, and is distinct from create_blob_reactive (which tracks blob position/reactivity — it does not draw the outline). Source can be the live camera (may prompt for macOS permission), a movie file, an animated synthetic blob (testable without a camera), or an existing TOP. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Threshold, Blur, and LineWidth controls. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

background.description: Background colour behind the traced contour (RGB 0..1).

edge_only.description: Run an Edge TOP before tracing so only the blob's boundary band is traced (hollow outline).

existing_top_path.description: Path of an existing TOP to trace; used only when source='existing_top'.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live Threshold, Blur, and LineWidth controls.

invert.description: Invert the mask so dark regions become the traced blob instead of bright ones.

line_width.description: Contour line width for the wireframe material.

movie_file_path.description: Path to a movie file to trace; used only when source='file'.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the blob-trace container is created (default '/project1').

pre_blur.description: Gaussian blur (pixels) before thresholding — smooths noisy edges into clean contours. Live 'Blur'.

source.description: Blob source. 'camera' = live webcam (may prompt for macOS camera permission). 'file' = a movie file (movie_file_path). 'synthetic' = an animated noise blob so the trace is testable with no device (the default). 'existing_top' = trace a TOP you already have (existing_top_path).

threshold.description: Luminance cutoff that separates blob (foreground) from background. Live 'Threshold'.
